g.text: ESD SENSITIVE. DC LOADS ONLY. NOT FOR MOTORS, RELAY COILS, MAINS
CHAIN LINKS: JP11-17 OPEN (IN1-7), JP18-19 SHUT (3V3, 5V)
CONN PWR LED: POWER ONLY. UNLIT DOES NOT MEAN SAFE OR UNPOWERED
TP: +3V3 HOST SIG GND EXT CONN GND
JP2 = CONN: 12V CLASS ONLY. JP1 HOST<=0.2A. NEVER BRIDGE ALL THREE PADS
